summary: Corrected a stale condition in a forwarded behaviour rather than leaving it understating its evidence: the entry that records how trim derives its bound still claimed that no execution had exercised trim after a drift, which the drift-then-trim receipt has since done. The statement is unchanged (trim takes the minimum of the leader's recorded accepted indexes, accepts an explicit index up to that minimum, and reports the minimum otherwise); the conditions now record the executed instance — recorded values 10, 9 and 7 over six indices of content, the minimum 7 taken and compacted — and cite the receipt's events (ec3329dc273e452aa92bcd44652c116a, indices 9-15), so the dependency the trim and parent accounts rely on shows its actual basis. No execution was requested this turn; incomplete are the parent drift's bound/repair probe after many more rounds and leader changes, the trim child's storage-side route probe, the snapshot child's peer and follower sampling, timers and loss triggers, larger clusters, persistence, and any further independent lead.
